p: Come: By this example God declared to Israel that the victory did not consist in multitude or armour, but only because of his grace.
uncircumcised: That is, the Philistines.
I am with thee according to: I will follow you wherever you go.
If they say thus unto us: This he spoke by the spirit of prophecy, and by this God gave him assurance of victory.
holes where they had hid themselves: Thus they spoke contemptuously and by derision.
his hands and upon his feet: That is, he crept up, or went up with all haste.
first slaughter: The second was when they slew one another, and the third when the Israelites chased them.
quaked: In that the insensible creatures tremble for fear of God's judgment, it declares how terrible his vengeance will be against his enemies.
Withdraw thine hand: Leave the Ephod alone, for I have no time now to ask counsel from God, Nu 27:21.
Israelites that were with Saul and: Though before for fear of the Philistines they declared themselves as enemies to their brethren.
Cursed be the man that eateth: Such was his hypocrisy and arrogancy, that he thought to attribute to his policy that which God had given by the hand of Jonathan.
oath: That is, the punishment if they break their oath.
eyes were enlightened: Which were dim before from weariness and hunger.
troubled the land: By making this cruel law.
roll a great stone unto me: That the blood of the beast that shall be slain, may be pressed out upon it.
draw near hither unto God: To ask counsel from him.
a perfect lot: Cause the lot to fall on him that has broken the oath, but he does not consider his presumption in commanding the same oath.
Shall Jonathan die: The people thought it their duty to rescue him, who out of ignorance had broken a rash law, and by whom they had received so great a benefit.
Amalekites: As the Lord had commanded, De 25:17.
and Ishui: Called also Abinadab, 1Sa 31:2.
Michal: Who was the wife of David, 1Sa 18:27.
Abner: Whom Joab, David's captain, slew 2sa 3:27.
and when Saul saw any strong: As Samuel had forewarned in 1Sa 8:11.
